overview: This file consists of a single list-of-papers or index sheet concerning Japanese news-gathering agencies operating in Hong Kong. It records a May 10 despatch from Southard at Hong Kong reporting that the Dōmei News Agency had opened a local office under Robert T. Moriguchi and points to a related file reference, “NCTL 846g.911.”

people.role: Sender of Hong Kong despatch no. 176

people.name: Robert T. Moriguchi
people.role: Person in charge of the Dōmei News Agency office in Hong Kong

subfiles.title: List of papers: Japanese news-gathering agencies in Hong Kong
subfiles.about: An index entry records the opening of a Dōmei News Agency office in Hong Kong under Robert T. Moriguchi.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists Hong Kong despatch no. 176 from Southard, dated May 10, concerning Japanese news-gathering activities. Its précis states that the Dōmei News Agency opened an office in Hong Kong and that Robert T. Moriguchi was placed in charge. It also supplies the related reference “NCTL 846g.911,” but the underlying despatch is not included on the surviving page.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it documents the institutional expansion of Japan’s Dōmei News Agency into British Hong Kong and identifies the official responsible for its local operation. The entry is useful as a finding aid because it supplies a despatch number, date, sender, personnel name, and related file reference that could lead historians to the fuller report.
